faq_heading: Questions people ask about AI SEO blog writers

faqs.q: What is an AI SEO blog writer?
faqs.a: It is software that drafts blog posts aimed at search keywords. Some only write a draft when you ask. Others also choose topics, publish, link pages, request indexing and report results.

faqs.q: Is an AI blog writer enough for a B2B website?
faqs.a: It is enough if someone on your team picks the topics, checks the facts, publishes and tracks results every week. If nobody has that time, the writing was never the bottleneck, and an agent that runs the whole loop fits better.

faqs.q: Will Google penalise posts written by AI?
faqs.a: Google says it rewards helpful, reliable content however it is produced, and that using automation mainly to manipulate rankings breaks its spam policy. Posts built on real facts that answer a buyer's question are on the safe side.

faqs.q: How do I stop an AI writer from inventing facts?
faqs.a: Give it an approved facts sheet and a rule that anything not on the sheet stays out. Keep client names, numbers and screenshots behind a human yes.

faqs.q: What is the difference between an AI writing tool and an AI SEO agent?
faqs.a: A tool produces a draft when you start it. An agent decides the topic, writes, publishes, links, asks Google to index and reports weekly, so the work happens without you starting it.
